Sonic Racing Crossworlds Year 2: Sega Still Has Answers to Give

short // Jun 23, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Hold up. How are we racing Evangelion's Unit-01 and actual Godzilla in Sonic Racing CrossWorlds?

I just saw the Year 2 trailer, and I had one thought: wasn't Big the Cat supposed to be the heavyweight? Now we've got building-sized mechs and kaiju pulling up to the starting line.

Sega, I need answers.

The questions I need answered

  • Is Godzilla going to squeeze into a tiny go-kart with no leg space?
  • Or is he going to stay a stage hazard while Baby Godzilla does all the racing? (Wait a minute. Baby Godzilla? Racing? Yo, kid, sign me up for that.)
  • Do Godzilla and Unit-01 get a completely separate "Mech and Kaiju" class, or does Sega just put them on giant hoverboards? The rumor going around was Extreme Gear-style boards to keep them massive on the track.

Nintendo has the Mega Mushroom. Sega looked at that and said, "That's cool and all, but we have Godzilla with a hoverboard."

Why Sega is going this big

This is Sonic's 35th anniversary year, and CrossWorlds is where Sega is going all out. Year 2 of the game's DLC is six packs, and pulling in Godzilla and Evangelion puts Sonic next to two of the biggest names in Japanese pop culture. It's a flex.

Update (September 2026): some answers

Sega has filled in some of the blanks since this video:

  • From what Sega has shown, Godzilla himself isn't driving. The Godzilla pack is built around three Godzilla-themed vehicles and a City Escape course that Godzilla has invaded, so he's basically the stage hazard I guessed. It's due in November.
  • The Evangelion pack puts Rei Ayanami and Asuka Langley Soryu on the track in Eva-inspired rides, with a Tokyo-3 course where Shinji's Unit-01 runs across the stage.
  • Year 2 has six DLC packs in total, and Bayonetta is the first free Year 2 character.
  • Sega planned a bigger Year 2 showcase for October.

Still no Baby Godzilla, though. Sega, I'm waiting.

Sources: VGC, The Sonic Stadium, Noisy Pixel

Quick answers

Is Godzilla in Sonic Racing CrossWorlds? Yes, through a Year 2 DLC pack with three Godzilla-themed vehicles and a City Escape course invaded by Godzilla, due in November 2026.

Is Evangelion in Sonic Racing CrossWorlds? Yes. The Evangelion pack adds Rei and Asuka as racers, with Eva-inspired rides and a Tokyo-3 course.

How many DLC packs are in Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Year 2? Six.

Is Bayonetta in Sonic Racing CrossWorlds? Yes. She's the first free Year 2 character.
